evidence.title: Minnesota's Tilt-A-Whirl Ride celebrates 100 years of thrills

occurrences.checkable_against: AP interview with Thomas Lauthier and Tilt-A-Whirl operating documentation
occurrences.quote_span: Weight from the riders shifts the cars’ positions as they lean, sending the cars off balance, said ride operator Thomas Lauthier, who brings his Tilt-A-Whirl to fairs around the country.
occurrences.speaker: Thomas Lauthier
occurrences.subject: Tilt-A-Whirl ride

occurrences.checkable_against: AP reporting notes and Minnesota State Fair ride-operation records for Aug. 27, 2026

occurrences.speaker: Samuel Mishek
occurrences.subject: Tilt-A-Whirl ride

occurrences.speaker: Mike Pream-Anderson
occurrences.subject: Tilt-A-Whirl ride
